news.title: Gold Falls to ~$4,136/oz on June 19; Down ~4% Over Month on Hawkish Fed Signals

news.title: Newmont Stock Down ~10% on the Week, ~15% on the Month Despite +89% 1-Year Return
news.summary: 주가 한 주 -10%, 한 달 -15.4% 조정(1년 +89.5%). 금값 풀백에 동반 약세, 밸류에이션 재점검 국면.

news.title: Newmont Tops Gold-Mining Stocks with Leading Quant Rating 4.18; Avg Target $141.46
